MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WITH p,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CAST(split(coalesce(p.death_date, '2026/10/15'), '/')[0] AS INT64) AS end_year,
     CAST(split(coalesce(p.death_date, '2026/10/15'), '/')[1] AS INT64) AS end_month,
     CAST(split(coalesce(p.death_date, '2026/10/15'), '/')[2] AS INT64) AS end_day
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2
ORDER BY col1
